description: This file contains unit tests for systemd availability detection functions using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions like classifySystemdUnavailableDetail, isSystemctlMissingDetail, and isSystemdUserBusUnavailableDetail to verify classification of systemd-related error messages.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for classifySystemdUnavailableDetail function

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an expectation/assertion for testing outcomes

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within a test suite

calls: expect(isSystemdUserBusUnavailableDetail("Failed to connect to user scope bus via local transport: $DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR not defined"))
expect(classifySystemdUnavailableDetail("systemctl --user unavailable: Failed to connect to bus: No medium found"))
expect(classifySystemdUnavailableDetail("System has not been booted with systemd as init system"))
